sentences.en: The flowers faded in the heat of the summer days.
sentences.zh: 夏天炎热的日子里，花朵逐渐凋谢。

sentences.en: Fighting the fading light he continued to count their names.
sentences.zh: 为了继续念出名字，他与渐暗的光线抗争。

sentences.en: As the sun rises, the morning mist gradually fades away.
sentences.zh: 随着太阳升起，晨雾渐渐消散。

senses.zh: [电影][电视] 淡出；[电影][电视] 淡入

mnemonic: 联想记忆：褪色（fade）的记忆何堪以对（face）
